description: This file defines a custom web component 'todo-footer' using LitElement, which renders the footer section of a TodoMVC application, including filters and a clear completed button.

classes.name: TodoFooter
classes.description: A LitElement-based web component that displays todo counts, filter links, and a clear completed button for a TodoMVC app.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the footer UI, including todo counts, filter links, and clear completed button.

methods.name: #onClearCompletedClick
methods.description: Handles click event to dispatch ClearCompletedEvent.
